slides.title: New interim government for Tigray
slides.body: Announced by PM Abiy Ahmed on Oct 16
The caretaker administration will serve six months to prepare for free and transparent elections, Abiy's office said.

slides.title: Rebuild and return home
slides.body: It is also meant to repair damaged infrastructure and help displaced people return home, Reuters reported.
Tigrayans were internally displaced as of February, according to the UN refugee agency, cited by Reuters.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Let displaced families return home.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
